text.tspan: How a switch learns MAC addresses, then forwards or floods
Known destination: forward to ONE port
note the SOURCE MAC of every
frame and the port it came in on
destination MAC is in the table:
send out of that port only
every port except the one it came in on
Hub = repeats everything to every port: one collision domain, no privacy. Switch = each port its own collision domain
(full duplex), but ALL ports are one broadcast domain; a router stops broadcasts. Linux bridge (docker0) = a software switch.
